text:
maria: Quick sync - plan to flip the SDK routing default next week but I don't want to ship blind. Console telemetry for per-route quotas is still missing; need to gate the flip.

aj: Agreed. We need at least: per-route token rate, error %, fallback_count, and extra_model_invocations. Current proxy sampling drops route hints ~25%.

diego: Can we roll a small canary? Feature flag `enable_new_routing_default` with rollout pct. Console shows a canary card listing routes + quick stats.

maria: Canary card should show tokens/sec, quota burn %, p95 latency, fallback_pct, and extra_tokens_from_fallback.

sdk-oliver: FYI Python SDK renames header to `X-RW-RouteHint` in v1.4.0. We can add server-side fallback logic but want clear telemetry to see who relied on the old header.

sdk-katie: Go/TS SDKs will include a transitional env var to preserve the old header name until customers upgrade. We'll log a deprecation warning at startup.

sre-sarah: If we add a shim, emit metric `redwood.route_hint_shim_hits{tenant}` and `redwood.extra_tokens_from_shim{tenant}`. Also add grafana panel and an alert.

aj: I'll add per-tenant sampling toggle `canary.route_hint_preserve = true` so canary orgs keep full headers. Non-canary remains untouched.

diego: Backend API: add `/internal/v1/route-telemetry?tenant=<id>`. Return flattened rows: route, tokens, quota_pct, fallbacks, extra_tokens. RBAC required.

product-anna: Docs: short migration FAQ + release blurb explaining header rename, shim behavior, opt-in canary steps, and deprecation timeline.

maria: Action items:
- aj: implement per-tenant header-preserve flag + console switch (owner: aj)
- sdk-oliver & sdk-katie: release shims in Python/TS/Go + deprecation logs (owners: oliver, katie)
- diego: route telemetry endpoint + RBAC (owner: diego)
- sre-sarah: metrics + grafana + alert (owner: sarah)
- product-anna: migration doc + release notes (owner: anna)

sdk-oliver: Shim implementation (server-side): `route = req.headers.get('X-RW-RouteHint') or req.headers.get('X-Redwood-Route')`. Log once per session. Tests will validate telemetry labels.

sdk-katie: TS will emit a client-side flag in telemetry to measure adoption.

aj: Smoke test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-RouteHint: chat.v1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/reply` then query `/internal/v1/route-telemetry?tenant=redwood-canary` to verify route shows up.

sre-sarah: Alerting: page if fallback_pct > 5% for 15m OR p95 latency up > 100ms for 10m. Add runbook link.

diego: UX Q: per-org toggle or per-project? Per-org simpler; we can add granularity later.

maria: Per-org for the initial canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `edge-proxy@route-preserve-canary` -> staging (hash: b4c3d2).

aj: Pushing config PR to staging now, enabling for `redwood-canary-org`.

sre-sarah: Will stand up grafana panels in staging and share links.

sdk-oliver: Opening Python PR with shim + tests in 3h.

sdk-katie: TS patch ready for review.

maria: Timeline: feature freeze Tue EOD, canary Wed AM, monitor Wed-Fri, decide Mon. Speak up if you need more time. :calendar:
